verifications.claim: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic autoimmune disease.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic neurological disorder" (R1); "Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an autoimmune disease" (R2); "Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an autoimmune disease" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated across multiple sources as chronic autoimmune disease affecting CNS.

verifications.claim: In multiple sclerosis (MS), the immune system attacks the protective myelin sheath covering nerve fibers in the brain and spinal cord.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "the immune system damages the myelin, a fatty substance that protects and insulates the nerve fibers in the central nervous system" (R1); "the immune system reacts against the central nervous system (CNS)... main target... myelin" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Precise description of immune attack on myelin in CNS matches exactly.

verifications.claim: Multiple sclerosis (MS) causes communication issues between the brain and body.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "disrupts the normal flow of electrical signals between the brain and the rest of the body" (R1); "slows down or blocks messages traveling along that nerve fiber" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported as disruption of signals between brain and body.

verifications.claim: Vision loss is a symptom of multiple sclerosis (MS).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Vision loss (usually affects one eye at a time)" (R3); "Partial or complete loss of vision" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly listed as a symptom in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Pain is a symptom of multiple sclerosis (MS).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Pain in eyes" (R1 early); "Painful muscle spasms" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Listed as symptom, e.g., eye pain, spasms.

verifications.claim: Fatigue is a symptom of multiple sclerosis (MS).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Fatigue" (R1 common); "Fatigue is a common and bothersome symptom" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Consistently listed as a primary symptom.

verifications.claim: Bladder dysfunction is an early sign of multiple sclerosis (MS).

verifications.evidence: "Bladder or bowel issues" (R1 common); "Changes in bladder or bowel function" (R2 symptoms)
verifications.reasoning: Bladder issues common, but not specifically flagged as early sign; early lists don't prioritize it.

verifications.evidence: "Attention and memory issues" (R1 common); "Mental or physical fatigue... cognitive changes" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Fatigue and cognitive issues mentioned, but cognitive fatigue not specifically early.
